# Ataraxy AI Sprint

> Ataraxy is an applied AI agency based in Montevideo, Uruguay, serving LATAM and the US. AI Sprint is a fixed-scope engagement to build and transfer a working AI system to the client team.

## Service

- [AI Sprint](https://sprint.ataraxydigital.com/): A fixed-scope engagement to build and transfer a working AI system to the client team.
- [How it works](https://sprint.ataraxydigital.com/#how): The delivery process and operating model.
- [Scope and ownership](https://sprint.ataraxydigital.com/#own): What the client receives and how the engagement works.

## Related Ataraxy services

- [Ataraxy](https://www.ataraxydigital.com/): Agency overview, implementation cases, and contact.
- [Agent Team](https://team.ataraxydigital.com/): Related applied AI service.
